subject: Private VPC Addendum + Renewal — proposed roadmap and timelines
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya@cloudpartners.io>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC addendum + renewal — sketching next steps

Hi Samir —

Hope you had a good weekend. Per our QBR, sounds like HelioHealth is ready to move the Private environment from a single VPC to a two-environment topology (prod + analytics) as part of the annual renewal. High level asks I heard:

- Full tenant isolation between Prod and Analytics (separate VPCs + network ACLs)
- Additional dedicated clusters (2 x n1-standard equivalents) to support nightly bulk inference and peak clinical workflows
- 12-month renewal with a one-time migration/engineering setup fee

I put together a quick starting plan attached (Helio_SOW_v1.pdf) with costs and an example timeline. If that matches expectations, we can:

1) Lock scope and term in the renewal amendment
2) Start a kickoff with SE & CS (network diagram + firewall rules)
3) Begin procurement paperwork so hardware provisioning slots can be reserved

Can we aim for an execution window in mid-May so the analytics environment is online before next quarter reporting? If that timeline is tight for procurement, tell me what dates work and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marissa (CS) and Logan (SE) on follow-ups.

Best,
Aisha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[aisha.rahman@redwood.ai]

[Attachment: Helio_SOW_v1.pdf]

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@heliohealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private VPC addendum + renewal — sketching next steps

Aisha — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifying notes from my side:

- Isolation: Prod must be air-gapped from Analytics for PHI-heavy jobs. That means separate VPCs and no cross-VPC peering for model inference traffic.
- Capacity: The analytics cluster needs GPU capacity for nightly batches (2x the current peak concurrent workers).
- Timeline: Procurement typically needs ~6 weeks for POs and PO approvals at our end — mid-May is doable if we start approvals this week.

Procurement contact looped (procurement@heliohealth.com) — they’ll need the SOW and formal pricing lines broken out for the PO. Also copying Priya (our integration partner) who will coordinate network changes.

Can you send a high-level network diagram (VPC CIDRs, NAT, peering avoidance) and a picklist for the provisioning order? Also need the contract amendment language for the term extension and the one-time migration fee to circulate to legal.

Samir
Head of Infrastructure, HelioHealth
samir.khan@heliohealth.com

--- Original Message ---,
On Sun, 28 Mar 2027 at 09:12 Aisha wrote:
> [Attachment: Helio_SOW_v1.pdf]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya@cloudpartners.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC addendum + renewal — sketching next steps

Great, thanks Samir — copying Marissa and Logan. Attached is a cleaned network diagram (network_diagram_v2.png) and a short provisioning picklist. Fast answers to help procurement:

- Order items (picklist):
  * 2 additional dedicated inference clusters (G4x-like profile)
  * Private VPC staging + private VPC analytics (customer-managed CIDRs)
  * One-time migration/validation engineering block (40 engineering hours)

- Term language (summary to insert into amendment):
  * 12 month renewal starting 2027-05-15 with a one-time professional services fee of $45,000 for migration and validation.
  * Dedicated capacity priced at $XX,XXX/mo for the pair of additional clusters (detailed lines in attached SOW).

I’ve attached a first-draft SOW and the diagram. Marissa — can CS own the onboarding plan (timeline + runbook)? Logan — can you confirm the capacity estimate and the SE checklist for air-gapped VPCs?

Aisha
[Attachments: network_diagram_v2.png, Helio_SOW_v1.pdf]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: HelioHealth renewal addendum — immediate asks

Marissa / Logan — quick internal thread to align before I send the consolidated package to procurement.

Marissa: can you draft a 6-week onboarding runbook that matches Helio’s procurement window? Key milestones: kickoff, network validation, cluster provisioning, smoke tests, final handoff. Please include rollback criteria and an operations contact. I attached a capacity estimate workbook — update any cost assumptions.

Logan: I need a checklist for air-gapped VPC setup (firewall rules, NAT behaviors, S3 endpoints, KMS integration steps) and confirmation that we can enforce no cross-VPC peering for inference. Also confirm the GPU profile baseline — current usage shows peaks that justify 2x cluster scale; I attached the usage snapshot.

Target: I’ll send the consolidated packet to Samir & Procurement by EOD Monday so they can start approvals.

Thanks —
Aisha
[Attachment: capacity_estimate_helio.xlsx]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>

Subject: Final renewal packet + DocuSign for SOW (HW-4729)

Samir / procurement — thanks for the quick responses. Attached are the finalized items you requested: updated SOW (Helio_SOW_v1.pdf), network diagram (network_diagram_v2.png), and a detailed capacity estimate (capacity_estimate_helio.xlsx). Highlights:

- Term: 12 months starting 2027-05-15
- One-time professional services (migration/validation): $45,000
- Monthly dedicated capacity for the 2 extra clusters: $28,500/mo
- Kickoff target week: 2027-05-17 (provisioning slots reserved conditional on PO)

For signatures: DocuSign link here: https://www.docusign.com/hellink/abc123-helio-sow

Next steps:
1) Procurement: Please confirm PO creation timeline and any required billing/legal contacts.
2) Priya: coordinate the network change window with Helio’s infra team.
3) Marissa / Logan: pending PO, we will schedule the kickoff and the four-week provisioning window.

If procurement can confirm a PO by 2027-04-16 we can meet the May kickoff.

Regards,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[aisha.rahman@redwood.ai]
